challenges.argument: The stated rule requires waiting in the zone and not necessarily a complete stop so counting mere presence over the long track before frame 150 could meet one and a half seconds.
The pixel threshold for standing still is uncalibrated and a twice looser threshold could treat slow creep as stopped long enough to reach the required dwell.
A twenty percent timing tolerance is within reasonable video quantization error and a stop just short of the threshold would become compliant under the shorter requirement.
Measuring at the object center instead of the bottom center could keep the point inside inspection continuously long enough to accumulate the required dwell.
